countEvidence.referenceAvailability: Saved JSON counter record is in Git; screenshot paths refer to original work directory and are not in this branch.

method.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; SM-S918B) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
method.readyCheck: Rendered central ready control pixel signature before tap; visible busy/STOP transition and stable return required to count
method.perCycleEvidence: Initial verifier saves prior full ready/settled PNG, moving PNG and after PNG. Slower continuation saves full moving/after PNGs and timestamps. Four early Foxy counter-confirmed cycles and five slower early moving captures lack distinct busy-pair PNGs; all30 are independently confirmed by the final provider counter.
method.audio: Parallel MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode tap from actual WebAudio output; original destination preserved. Exported after each batch; video itself is silent.
method.oneTableLimit: Only normal visible Exit and normal context close/re-entry. No token changes, authentication, provider state clearing or limit bypass.

limitations: Historical Git-retained observation journal supplies exact completed native counter and cycle evidence. Its raw PNG/audio paths refer to an earlier workspace and have not been recovered locally.
Provider receipts were not independently validated in that historical batch; public completed counter was directly observed.
No claim of provider probabilities, RTP or full equivalence.
Newer fresh sessions stay separate and must be added; historical counts are never reduced to20.
These are retained historical verified lower bounds, not a complete count of every past attempt.
Some raw original PNG/audio/capture paths are unavailable; exact native counter journals or ordered stored result/balance chains remain in Git.
Repeated branch blobs, snapshot counters within the same session, local component/evaluator replays and unresolved r12/r16/r21 claims add zero.
Historical stakes outside the new1–20 test presets are preserved as actually observed, not rewritten.
